description:
HushTelegram v0.0.22 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the Google Play build 13.1.1 (org.telegram.messenger) with 67 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. This release builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0. Most of what's new came from your reports. There's a Ghost mode for read receipts and stories, a switch that blocks new channels and groups on a kid's phone, and Copy, Save to Downloads and Forward as copy for chats that don't allow saving. Every new switch starts off.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 1634 runtime tests passed locally. All 552 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 67 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (version code 72299) and the Google Play build 13.1.1 (version code 72371), and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment. Both builds, patched from this bundle, were installed over an older HushTelegram on a Galaxy S22 and the whole HushTelegram settings screen was walked with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 or the Google Play build 13.1.1. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram, patch the same build you're on and install it over your current one with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has one more switch, **Add Forward as copy to the message menu**, off by default. With it on, a message in a chat that doesn't allow forwarding gets a Forward as copy item. Pick a chat and the message's text, or its downloaded photo or file, goes there as a new message. Media you haven't downloaded yet asks you to open it first. (#46, #47)
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has another new switch, **Add Save to Downloads to the message menu**, off by default. With it on, a photo, video, file or song you've already downloaded from a chat that doesn't allow saving gets a Save to Downloads item in its long-press menu. Tap it and the file is copied to Download/Telegram. Nothing is copied until you tap, even with the two automatic save switches off. (#29)
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch under it, **Copy text from chats that don't allow saving**, off by default. Turn it on and a message in a chat or channel that blocks saving gets a Copy item in its long-press menu, and you can select its text and copy it like anywhere else. Forwarding, screenshots and the rest of the restriction stay as they are. (#43)
* **Telegram:** **Disable double-tap reactions** has two new switches under it, both off by default. **Hide reactions under messages** stops the row of reactions from being drawn under each message, and **Hide the reaction picker** removes the row of reactions at the top of the long-press menu along with the panel it opens. Nothing stored is changed, so turning a switch off brings everything back. Tags in Saved Messages still show. (#48)
* **Telegram:** **Hide recommendations** has a new switch under it, **Hide trending packs**, off by default. Turn it on and the sticker keyboard loses its Trending tab and the trending row under your packs, and the emoji keyboard stops listing packs you haven't added. Search still finds new packs, and the Stickers and Emoji screen in Settings still shows Telegram's trending list.
* **Telegram:** **Hide Premium, gifts and Stars** has a new switch under it, **Hide emoji statuses**, off by default. Turn it on and the emoji a Premium account puts next to its name is gone from chats, the chat list and profiles, so you see the plain Premium star instead. Your own status hides on your phone too, but everyone else still sees it. Picking a new status for a channel you run still saves.
* **Telegram:** **Hide Premium, gifts and Stars** also has **Unlock Premium app icons**, off by default. With it on, Premium, Turbo and Nox in Telegram's App Icon list (Settings, Appearance) have no lock and switch your home screen icon like the others, instead of opening the Premium sheet. They show in the list even where Telegram sells no Premium. Only the icon on your phone changes. (#13, #14)
* **Telegram:** **Hide Premium, gifts and Stars** also has **Emoji status on this phone**, off by default. With it on, the star next to Telegram at the top of the chat list opens the emoji status picker without Premium, and the emoji you pick, animated ones too, shows there on your phone. Nobody else sees it and nothing goes to Telegram. Picking no status puts the star back. (#14)
* **Telegram:** **HushTelegram icon and name** has an **Icon style** option in Morphe Manager. Besides the blue badge you can pick **White on black** or **Black on white**, which draw just the H and plane in one color. The plain styles need Android 8 or newer, and Android 13's themed icon still works with any of them. (#37)
* **Telegram:** **Hide channel bar buttons** has a new switch under it, **Hide channel share button**, off by default. With it on, the round share button beside channel posts goes away, in the channel itself and in any chat a channel post gets forwarded to. A post's own menu still forwards it. Bots, people's media in public groups and Saved Messages keep their button.
* **Telegram:** **Stop usage reports** has a new switch under it, **Ghost mode**, off by default. It has two parts, **No read receipts** and **View stories anonymously**, which start on. With Ghost mode on, people don't see the messages you read as read, in private chats, groups and secret chats, and voice messages you play stay unplayed for them. Stories you watch don't add you to the viewer list. Sending a message in a chat still marks it read, since Telegram does that on its side, and your other devices keep showing chats you read here as unread. The diagnostic report counts the read receipts and story views it kept back. (#45)
* **Telegram:** **Hide popular apps** has a new switch under it, **Block new channels and groups**, off by default. It's meant as a parental control. With it on, joining a channel or group doesn't go through, whether it's from search, an invite link or a shared folder link, and a channel or group you aren't in won't open, forums included. A short message says new chats are blocked in the HushTelegram settings. Chats you're already in work as before. Turn on **Lock HushTelegram settings** too, or the switch can just be turned off again. On a blocked invite or folder link, Telegram also says it can't find the group or folder. The diagnostic report counts the joins and chats it stopped. (#44)
* **Telegram:** Reactions to your messages now show a notification on patched builds, which Google's push never reaches. **UnifiedPush notifications** has a new switch under it, **Reaction notifications without push**, on by default. While Telegram is connected, someone reacting to one of your messages gets the same "reacted to your message" notification Telegram shows from a push, once per reaction. Telegram's own **Reactions** switch in Notifications and Sounds still has to be on. (#41)
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and morphe-desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you add this release. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 or newer.
* **Telegram:** When **Quiet**, **Privacy** or **Back to defaults** in Quick setups finds nothing to change, it now says everything was already set that way. It used to say "Changed 0 settings", which sounded like something went wrong.
* **Telegram:** **Export settings** and **Import settings** now show how the last try went at the top of the row, along with the pop-up message. At large text sizes Android cuts that message off after two lines, so a reason like "That isn't a HushTelegram settings file" lost its end.
* **Telegram:** The diagnostic report now counts the GIFs, voice messages and other media that **Save downloaded files** leaves in Telegram, next to the files it copies and the ones it keeps back. (#7)
* **Telegram:** **Ask before sending a voice or video message** pauses the recording before it asks, the way Telegram does before its own paid-message question, so nothing you say or film while the question is up ends up in the message. Send sends the clip as it was. Cancel leaves it paused in Telegram's preview, where you can play it, delete it or send it. The send button under that preview asks too, and Cancel there keeps the clip just as it was.
* **Telegram:** When **Hide All Chats** is on but All Chats is still in the tabs, its description in the settings now says why. Either nothing else opens Archived Chats (turn on the side menu to fix that), your account has no folder of its own to open, or the folder tabs couldn't be read. The diagnostic report counts the same reasons. (#38)
* **Telegram:** Turning **Hide Stories** on or off now shows the restart button in the settings. Telegram sets up the Post Story button and loads the story list when the chat list opens, so before, the button stayed (or stayed away) until Telegram happened to restart, and nothing told you a restart was needed.
* **Telegram:** With **Full screen videos turn either way** or **Turn videos only from the full screen button** on, turning your phone upright no longer takes a video out of full screen. Telegram ends full screen on its own once the phone has been on its side and comes back upright, which with either switch on left the video standing up and stuck that way until you tapped the button again. Full screen now lasts until you tap the button or close the video. (#27)
* **Telegram:** When a settings editor can't save what you typed, the reason under the field stays on screen at large text sizes with the keyboard up. The cursor used to scroll it right back out of sight.
* **Telegram:** The API key field in **Translation service** uses the same letters as the fields above it. Its hint used to show in a typewriter font.
* **Telegram:** On a narrow screen or with large text, the HushTelegram settings search box says Search instead of a cut-off "Search settings". TalkBack still reads it as Search settings.
* **Telegram:** **Save downloaded files** no longer puts the wrong file in Download/Telegram when two documents have the same name and size. Telegram stores a document under its own name, and when a second one of that name and size arrives it opens the first one's file without downloading anything. That file used to be copied as the second document. Now it stays in Telegram.
* **Telegram:** With the HushTelegram settings open, tapping a Telegram link in another app now closes them and shows the chat. The chat used to open behind the settings, so you had to back out of them to see it. Tapping Telegram's icon still brings the settings back as you left them.
* **Telegram:** With TalkBack on, tapping **Pause** at the top of the HushTelegram settings now moves focus to the card that says Telegram will pause, where its Undo button is. Before, focus went nowhere once the button stepped aside.
* **Telegram:** In the HushTelegram settings, the search box's outline now goes all the way around while you type. The X that clears the search used to cover its right end.
* **Telegram:** With **Keep Telegram's files in internal storage** on, files Telegram downloaded before you turned it on open from Android/data again instead of downloading a second copy. New downloads still land in Internal storage/Telegram. (#7)
* **Telegram:** Chats hidden with **Hide picked chats** no longer count toward the unread numbers on the folder tabs, and hiding or unhiding one updates them right away, on every account you're signed in to. The app badge still counts their unread messages, since they keep their notifications. (#24)
* **Telegram:** The settings lock now covers **Emoji next to the chat list title** too. While the settings are locked, tapping it shows the lock note instead of opening the editor. (#17)
* **Telegram:** Turning **Hide folder tab counters** on or off changes the folder tabs right away. Before, the counts stayed as they were until Telegram restarted.
* **Telegram:** **Open a folder at launch** brings the folder you picked into view. With more folders than fit across the screen, a pick past the edge used to open selected but out of sight until you scrolled the tabs. With fewer folders the tabs look just as they did.
* **Telegram:** TalkBack reads a settings section's state once. Section titles like Ads and Look and feel said "Collapsed, Collapsed" (or "Expanded, Expanded") before the name, because TalkBack already says the state for anything that opens and closes. They still read as headings. (#18)
* **Telegram:** Long words in the HushTelegram settings break where their language hyphenates them. At large text sizes German compounds used to split at whatever letter filled the line, and a name like Firebase-Push-Registrierung moved its hyphen to the start of the next line. Dialog titles, dialog messages and choice lists break the same way now.
* **Telegram:** **UnifiedPush notifications** makes one set of encryption keys the first time it signs up, even when Telegram's own sign-up and a new address from the push app ask for them at the same moment. Two sets could get made, with Telegram signed up on the one that wasn't kept, so turning the switch off later didn't hand notifications back to Firebase until Telegram restarted. Keys that couldn't be saved also stay out of later sign-ups until the next start.
* **Telegram:** **Keep edit history** starts a message's history over when what it kept for that message can't be read anymore. Before, one damaged entry meant that message never kept an earlier text again.
* **Telegram:** Patching with **Use registered Telegram API credentials** from the Morphe command line explains a missing API ID. The command line drops a bare number like `-O apiId=12345` before the patch sees it, and the old message only asked you to fill in both fields. Quote the ID as `-O "apiId='12345'"` and it goes through.
* **Telegram:** With **Hide channel Mute button** on, the bar at the bottom of a channel comes back the way Telegram last set it once the channel stops showing Mute. If Telegram hid the bar while it was held back, or changed it with the switch off, the bar used to reappear anyway.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.
HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews

patches.name: Disable pull to archive

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel

patches.name: Exact numbers

patches.name: Faster downloads

A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. patches.name: Folders by chat type

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap

release_notes:
HushTelegram v0.0.22 has 67 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). It's built on Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you patch. Most of this one came straight from your reports. There's a Ghost mode for read receipts and stories, a switch that blocks new channels and groups for a kid's phone, and Copy, Save to Downloads and Forward as copy for chats that don't allow saving. You can hide reactions and the reaction picker, unlock the Premium app icons, and pick an emoji status that only your phone sees. Full screen videos stay full screen when you turn the phone upright, and reactions to your messages notify you now on builds Google's push doesn't reach. Every new switch starts off.

New in this release

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has one more switch, `Add Forward as copy to the message menu`, off by default. With it on, a message in a chat that doesn't allow forwarding gets a Forward as copy item. Pick a chat and the message's text, or its downloaded photo or file, goes there as a new message. Media you haven't downloaded yet asks you to open it first. (#46, #47)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has another new switch, `Add Save to Downloads to the message menu`, off by default. With it on, a photo, video, file or song you've already downloaded from a chat that doesn't allow saving gets a Save to Downloads item in its long-press menu. Tap it and the file is copied to Download/Telegram. Nothing is copied until you tap, even with the two automatic save switches off. (#29)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch under it, `Copy text from chats that don't allow saving`, off by default. Turn it on and a message in a chat or channel that blocks saving gets a Copy item in its long-press menu, and you can select its text and copy it like anywhere else. Forwarding, screenshots and the rest of the restriction stay as they are. (#43)

- `Disable double-tap reactions` has two new switches under it, both off by default. `Hide reactions under messages` stops the row of reactions from being drawn under each message, and `Hide the reaction picker` removes the row of reactions at the top of the long-press menu along with the panel it opens. Nothing stored is changed, so turning a switch off brings everything back. Tags in Saved Messages still show. (#48)

- `Hide recommendations` has a new switch under it, `Hide trending packs`, off by default. Turn it on and the sticker keyboard loses its Trending tab and the trending row under your packs, and the emoji keyboard stops listing packs you haven't added. Search still finds new packs, and the Stickers and Emoji screen in Settings still shows Telegram's trending list.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` has a new switch under it, `Hide emoji statuses`, off by default. Turn it on and the emoji a Premium account puts next to its name is gone from chats, the chat list and profiles, so you see the plain Premium star instead. Your own status hides on your phone too, but everyone else still sees it. Picking a new status for a channel you run still saves.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` also has `Unlock Premium app icons`, off by default. With it on, Premium, Turbo and Nox in Telegram's App Icon list (Settings, Appearance) have no lock and switch your home screen icon like the others, instead of opening the Premium sheet. They show in the list even where Telegram sells no Premium. Only the icon on your phone changes. (#13, #14)

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` also has `Emoji status on this phone`, off by default. With it on, the star next to Telegram at the top of the chat list opens the emoji status picker without Premium, and the emoji you pick, animated ones too, shows there on your phone. Nobody else sees it and nothing goes to Telegram. Picking no status puts the star back. (#14)

- `HushTelegram icon and name` has an `Icon style` option in Morphe Manager. Besides the blue badge you can pick `White on black` or `Black on white`, which draw just the H and plane in one color. The plain styles need Android 8 or newer, and Android 13's themed icon still works with any of them. (#37)

- `Hide channel bar buttons` has a new switch under it, `Hide channel share button`, off by default. With it on, the round share button beside channel posts goes away, in the channel itself and in any chat a channel post gets forwarded to. A post's own menu still forwards it. Bots, people's media in public groups and Saved Messages keep their button.

- `Stop usage reports` has a new switch under it, `Ghost mode`, off by default. It has two parts, `No read receipts` and `View stories anonymously`, which start on. With Ghost mode on, people don't see the messages you read as read, in private chats, groups and secret chats, and voice messages you play stay unplayed for them. Stories you watch don't add you to the viewer list. Sending a message in a chat still marks it read, since Telegram does that on its side, and your other devices keep showing chats you read here as unread. The diagnostic report counts the read receipts and story views it kept back. (#45)

- `Hide popular apps` has a new switch under it, `Block new channels and groups`, off by default. It's meant as a parental control. With it on, joining a channel or group doesn't go through, whether it's from search, an invite link or a shared folder link, and a channel or group you aren't in won't open, forums included. A short message says new chats are blocked in the HushTelegram settings. Chats you're already in work as before. Turn on `Lock HushTelegram settings` too, or the switch can just be turned off again. On a blocked invite or folder link, Telegram also says it can't find the group or folder. The diagnostic report counts the joins and chats it stopped. (#44)

- Reactions to your messages now show a notification on patched builds, which Google's push never reaches. `UnifiedPush notifications` has a new switch under it, `Reaction notifications without push`, on by default. While Telegram is connected, someone reacting to one of your messages gets the same "reacted to your message" notification Telegram shows from a push, once per reaction. Telegram's own `Reactions` switch in Notifications and Sounds still has to be on. (#41)

Fixes

- With `Full screen videos turn either way` or `Turn videos only from the full screen button` on, turning your phone upright no longer takes a video out of full screen. Telegram ends full screen on its own once the phone has been on its side and comes back upright, which with either switch on left the video standing up and stuck that way until you tapped the button again. Full screen now lasts until you tap the button or close the video. (#27)

- When a settings editor can't save what you typed, the reason under the field stays on screen at large text sizes with the keyboard up. The cursor used to scroll it right back out of sight.

- The API key field in `Translation service` uses the same letters as the fields above it. Its hint used to show in a typewriter font.

- On a narrow screen or with large text, the HushTelegram settings search box says Search instead of a cut-off "Search settings". TalkBack still reads it as Search settings.

- `Save downloaded files` no longer puts the wrong file in Download/Telegram when two documents have the same name and size. Telegram stores a document under its own name, and when a second one of that name and size arrives it opens the first one's file without downloading anything. That file used to be copied as the second document. Now it stays in Telegram.

- With the HushTelegram settings open, tapping a Telegram link in another app now closes them and shows the chat. The chat used to open behind the settings, so you had to back out of them to see it. Tapping Telegram's icon still brings the settings back as you left them.

- With TalkBack on, tapping `Pause` at the top of the HushTelegram settings now moves focus to the card that says Telegram will pause, where its Undo button is. Before, focus went nowhere once the button stepped aside.

- In the HushTelegram settings, the search box's outline now goes all the way around while you type. The X that clears the search used to cover its right end.

- With `Keep Telegram's files in internal storage` on, files Telegram downloaded before you turned it on open from Android/data again instead of downloading a second copy. New downloads still land in Internal storage/Telegram. (#7)

- Chats hidden with `Hide picked chats` no longer count toward the unread numbers on the folder tabs, and hiding or unhiding one updates them right away, on every account you're signed in to. The app badge still counts their unread messages, since they keep their notifications. (#24)

- The settings lock now covers `Emoji next to the chat list title` too. While the settings are locked, tapping it shows the lock note instead of opening the editor. (#17)

- Turning `Hide folder tab counters` on or off changes the folder tabs right away. Before, the counts stayed as they were until Telegram restarted.

- `Open a folder at launch` brings the folder you picked into view. With more folders than fit across the screen, a pick past the edge used to open selected but out of sight until you scrolled the tabs. With fewer folders the tabs look just as they did.

- TalkBack reads a settings section's state once. Section titles like Ads and Look and feel said "Collapsed, Collapsed" (or "Expanded, Expanded") before the name, because TalkBack already says the state for anything that opens and closes. They still read as headings. (#18)

- Long words in the HushTelegram settings break where their language hyphenates them. At large text sizes German compounds used to split at whatever letter filled the line, and a name like Firebase-Push-Registrierung moved its hyphen to the start of the next line. Dialog titles, dialog messages and choice lists break the same way now.

- `UnifiedPush notifications` makes one set of encryption keys the first time it signs up, even when Telegram's own sign-up and a new address from the push app ask for them at the same moment. Two sets could get made, with Telegram signed up on the one that wasn't kept, so turning the switch off later didn't hand notifications back to Firebase until Telegram restarted. Keys that couldn't be saved also stay out of later sign-ups until the next start.

- `Keep edit history` starts a message's history over when what it kept for that message can't be read anymore. Before, one damaged entry meant that message never kept an earlier text again.

- Patching with `Use registered Telegram API credentials` from the Morphe command line explains a missing API ID. The command line drops a bare number like `-O apiId=12345` before the patch sees it, and the old message only asked you to fill in both fields. Quote the ID as `-O "apiId='12345'"` and it goes through.

- With `Hide channel Mute button` on, the bar at the bottom of a channel comes back the way Telegram last set it once the channel stops showing Mute. If Telegram hid the bar while it was held back, or changed it with the switch off, the bar used to reappear anyway.

Other changes

- HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.1.0, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and morphe-desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you add this release. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 1.20.0 or newer.

- When `Quiet`, `Privacy` or `Back to defaults` in Quick setups finds nothing to change, it now says everything was already set that way. It used to say "Changed 0 settings", which sounded like something went wrong.

- `Export settings` and `Import settings` now show how the last try went at the top of the row, along with the pop-up message. At large text sizes Android cuts that message off after two lines, so a reason like "That isn't a HushTelegram settings file" lost its end.

- The diagnostic report now counts the GIFs, voice messages and other media that `Save downloaded files` leaves in Telegram, next to the files it copies and the ones it keeps back. (#7)

- `Ask before sending a voice or video message` pauses the recording before it asks, the way Telegram does before its own paid-message question, so nothing you say or film while the question is up ends up in the message. Send sends the clip as it was. Cancel leaves it paused in Telegram's preview, where you can play it, delete it or send it. The send button under that preview asks too, and Cancel there keeps the clip just as it was.

- When `Hide All Chats` is on but All Chats is still in the tabs, its description in the settings now says why. Either nothing else opens Archived Chats (turn on the side menu to fix that), your account has no folder of its own to open, or the folder tabs couldn't be read. The diagnostic report counts the same reasons. (#38)

- Turning `Hide Stories` on or off now shows the restart button in the settings. Telegram sets up the Post Story button and loads the story list when the chat list opens, so before, the button stayed (or stayed away) until Telegram happened to restart, and nothing told you a restart was needed.

Behind the scenes

- `release.ps1 -Stage publish` takes a walk receipt for each Telegram build the bundle patches, so `-Walk` names one for telegram.org's build and one for the Play build. It refuses to publish when either is missing, or when the Play build's walk was signed out. Until now one walk of the web build was enough, and nothing had opened the Play build's screens past sign-in.

- The release notes are laid out like the other Hush projects' now. New features, fixes and other changes each get their own heading, the scope labels are gone, setting names show in code style, and the notes end with how to update and what was checked. The CHANGELOG sorts each version's bullets under Added, Changed and Fixed to match.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.3.0 or newer. This release is built on a newer patcher than Manager 2.2.0 carries, so update Manager first or it won't load the patches.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get the right Telegram. From Google Play that's 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371), which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. From telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) it's 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.21? Patch the APK of the same build you're on and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch. The icon now has an `Icon style` option too.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 1634 runtime tests passed locally, and all 552 patch tests passed too (162 unit tests and 390 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (version code 72299) and to the Google Play build of 13.1.1 (version code 72371). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 21 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either. On the Google Play build, a long press on the chat list title still opened the HushTelegram settings with a short vibration, and a plain tap on it still scrolled the list back to the top.

Several of the new switches were also tried on a Galaxy S25 running telegram.org's build. `Emoji status on this phone` showed the picked status in the chat list title and kept it after Telegram restarted. `Hide trending packs`, `Hide channel share button` and `Hide emoji statuses` each hid their part when turned on and brought it back when turned off. On the S22, `Save downloaded files` copied the right file when two documents shared a name and size.
repoDescription: HushTelegram v0.0.20: Morphe patches that take sponsored messages, search ads, Stories and upsells out of Telegram and keep its usage reports on your phone. 67 patches for Telegram 13.1.0.
